mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/b3d44b3b7f5d-t1/ws/prep_48A5 && cat > /srv/leakruns/b3d44b3b7f5d-t1/ws/prep_48A5/prepare.py <<'EOF'
"""design_48A5 모델링 준비: 예측 시점(tp) 단위 코호트·결과·특징 테이블과 분할 생성 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

WS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D, OUT = WS / "data", WS / "prep_48A5"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_48A5.json").read_text())
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
l = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
l = l.merge(a[["admission_id", "admit_time", "discharge_time"]], on="admission_id")

# 1) 예측 시점: 입원 후 offset 시점에 아직 입원 중인 경우만 ("입원 중 매일")
tps = []
for off in design["tp"]["offsets_h"]:
    t = a.assign(offset_h=off, tp=a.admit_time + off * H)
    tps.append(t[t.tp < t.discharge_time])
tp = pd.concat(tps, ignore_index=True).merge(p, on="patient_id")
tp["tp_id"] = tp.admission_id + "_" + tp.offset_h.astype(str)
n0 = len(tp)

cr = l[l.test == "creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")
cr_by_adm = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}

def kdigo_flags(g, times_col, ref_col="collect_time"):
    """g의 각 크레아티닌이 같은 입원 내 이전 값 대비 KDIGO(48h +0.3, 7일 최솟값 1.5배)를 만족하는지."""
    t, v = g[ref_col].values, g.value.values
    out = np.zeros(len(g), bool)
    for i in range(len(g)):
        prev48 = v[(t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(48, "h"))]
        prev7d = v[(t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(168, "h"))]
        out[i] = (len(prev48) and v[i] - prev48.min() >= 0.3) or (len(prev7d) and v[i] >= 1.5 * prev7d.min())
    return out

aki_flag = {k: kdigo_flags(g, "collect_time") for k, g in cr_by_adm.items()}

def per_tp(row):
    g = cr_by_adm.get(row.admission_id)
    if g is None:
        return pd.Series(dict(aki_known=False, aki_48h=0, n_cr_window=0, n_cr_stay=0, window_censored=False, n_cr_by_tp=0))
    f = aki_flag[row.admission_id]
    known = bool((f & (g.report_time <= row.tp).values).any())  # 제외: tp까지 보고된 AKI
    w = ((g.collect_time > row.tp) & (g.collect_time <= row.tp + 48 * H)).values
    return pd.Series(dict(
        aki_known=known,
        aki_48h=int((f & w).any()),
        n_cr_window=int(w.sum()),
        n_cr_stay=len(g),
        n_cr_by_tp=int((g.report_time <= row.tp).sum()),
        window_censored=bool(row.discharge_time < row.tp + 48 * H),
    ))

tp = pd.concat([tp, tp.apply(per_tp, axis=1)], axis=1)

# 2) 코호트 (설계서 그대로)
flow = [("입원 중 tp 후보", n0)]
tp = tp[tp.age >= 18]; flow.append(("adult", len(tp)))
tp_all_cr = tp.copy()
tp = tp[tp.n_cr_stay >= 3]; flow.append(("cr_monitored (admit~discharge, 설계 그대로)", len(tp)))
tp = tp[~tp.aki_known]; flow.append(("exclude aki_known_by_tp", len(tp)))
# 비교용: 미래 정보 없는 대안 (tp까지 보고된 크레아티닌 >=3)
alt = tp_all_cr[(tp_all_cr.n_cr_by_tp >= 3) & ~tp_all_cr.aki_known]

# 3) 특징 (tp 기준, report_time <= tp). cr_peak_48h는 결과 창 정보라 행렬에서 제외 → 별도 열로만 보관
lab_feats = [f for f in design["features"] if f["source"] == "labs"]
def lab_feature(f):
    test = f["filter"]["test"]
    sub = l[l.test.isin(test)][["admission_id", "value", f["time_column"], "collect_time"]].rename(columns={f["time_column"]: "ft"})
    m = tp[["tp_id", "admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]].merge(sub, on="admission_id")
    s, e = f["window"]["start"], f["window"]["end"]
    def bound(x):
        if x == "admit": return m.admit_time
        if x == "tp": return m.tp
        sign = 1 if "+" in x else -1
        return m.tp + sign * int(x.split("+" if sign > 0 else "-")[1].rstrip("h")) * H
    lo, hi = bound(s), bound(e)
    m = m[(m.ft >= lo) & ((m.ft <= hi) if e == "tp" or "-" in e else (m.ft <= hi)) & ((m.ft > lo) if s == "tp" else True)]
    m = m.sort_values(["tp_id", "ft", "collect_time"])
    agg = {"min": "min", "max": "max", "count": "size", "last": "last"}[f["agg"]]
    r = m.groupby("tp_id").value.agg(agg)
    return r.reindex(tp.tp_id).fillna(0 if agg == "size" else np.nan).values

X = pd.DataFrame({"tp_id": tp.tp_id.values})
for f in design["features"]:
    if f["source"] == "labs":
        X[f["name"]] = lab_feature(f)
    elif f["source"] == "patients":
        X[f["name"]] = tp[f["column"]].values
    elif f["source"] == "admissions":
        X[f["name"]] = tp[f["column"]].values
LEAKY = ["cr_peak_48h"]
X_model = X.drop(columns=LEAKY)

# 4) 분할: family_id 결측(가족 정보 없음)은 patient_id로 대체한 그룹 키 사용
tp["split_group"] = tp.family_id.fillna("PT_" + tp.patient_id)
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
groups = np.array(sorted(tp.split_group.unique()))
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
tp["split"] = np.where(tp.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

# 설계 키 그대로 썼을 때의 환자 중복 점검 (family_id 결측을 하나의 그룹으로 묶거나 버리는 경우)
naive = tp.dropna(subset=["family_id"])

# 5) 저장 및 요약
cols = ["tp_id", "admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "unit", "offset_h", "tp",
        "aki_48h", "n_cr_window", "window_censored", "discharge_status"]
tp[cols].reset_index(drop=True).merge(X_model, on="tp_id").to_csv(OUT / "tp_dataset.csv.gz", index=False)
X[["tp_id"] + LEAKY].to_csv(OUT / "quarantined_features.csv.gz", index=False)

pt_split = tp.groupby("patient_id").split.nunique()
summ = dict(
    flow=flow,
    n_tp=len(tp), n_adm=tp.admission_id.nunique(), n_pt=tp.patient_id.nunique(),
    prevalence=tp.aki_48h.mean(),
    by_unit=tp.groupby("unit").agg(n=("aki_48h", "size"), aki_rate=("aki_48h", "mean"), cr_per_window=("n_cr_window", "mean"),
                                  no_cr_in_window=("n_cr_window", lambda s: (s == 0).mean())).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    by_offset=tp.groupby("offset_h").aki_48h.agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    window_censored=tp.window_censored.mean(),
    aki_rate_censored_vs_not=tp.groupby("window_censored").aki_48h.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    died_in_cohort=(tp.discharge_status == "died").mean(),
    alt_cohort_n=len(alt), alt_cohort_prev=alt.aki_48h.mean(),
    cohort_vs_alt_unit=dict(design=tp.unit.value_counts(normalize=True).round(3).to_dict(), alt=alt.unit.value_counts(normalize=True).round(3).to_dict()),
    family_missing_rate_tp=tp.family_id.isna().mean(),
    patients_in_both_splits=int((pt_split > 1).sum()),
    split_counts=tp.groupby("split").agg(n=("aki_48h", "size"), prev=("aki_48h", "mean")).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    naive_dropna_kept=len(naive) / len(tp),
    missing_rate=X_model.isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    cr_peak_missing_when_outcome0=X.loc[tp.aki_48h.values == 0, "cr_peak_48h"].isna().mean(),
    cr_peak_missing_when_outcome1=X.loc[tp.aki_48h.values == 1, "cr_peak_48h"].isna().mean(),
)
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summ, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summ, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str))
